caption: The video captures a snowy outdoor forest floor where a person in a light-gray long-sleeved top kneels behind a small fire built on a snow-dusted log. A fallen trunk rests at the upper left, and curled pieces of birch bark lie at the right, framing the central flame. The person holds a dense bundle of thin, leafless twigs over a bed of burning bark, with hands cupping the bundle from either side. The bundle partly obscures the person's torso. Throughout, the bundle remains above the flame while the hands reposition it, with slight tilting and movement toward the fire. The flame at the base grows modestly, shifting from a small orange glow within the bark to taller yellow flame tongues. A faint rising haze appears above the twigs as the fire brightens, gently drifting intermittently upward. Background elements remain broadly fixed, with only slight framing shifts.

A fallen trunk rests at the upper left, and curled pieces of birch bark lie at the right, framing the central flame. The person holds a dense bundle of thin, leafless twigs over a bed of burning bark, with hands cupping the bundle from either side. Throughout the excerpt, the bundle remains above the flame while the hands reposition slightly and the twigs tilt and settle a little lower toward the fire.
